arabic text: Paas Zainab ke bacha kya hai jo ghar lejaaye\nKis terha apni tabahi ki khabar lejaye
english translation text: What remains with Zainab that she can take home?\nHow can she carry home the news of her own destruction?

arabic text: Paas Zainab ke bacha kya hai jo ghar lejaaye\nKis terha apni tabahi ki khabar lejaye
english translation text: What remains with Zainab that she can take home?\nHow can she carry home the news of her own destruction?

arabic text:
(Lai gayee baap ka saya to saro(n) se unke) 
Ab Yateemon ko hawa chaahe jidhar le jaaye
Paas Zainab ke bacha kya hai jo ghar lejaaye
Kis terha apni tabahi ki khabar lejaye
english translation text:
Their father's shade has been taken from above their heads
Now the wind may carry the orphans wherever it wishes
What remains with Zainab that she can take home?
How can she carry home the news of her own destruction?

arabic text:
Aik do gul ke charaghon ko bujha de leykin
Cheen ker koi na umeedai(n), sahar lai jaayai
Paas Zainab ke bacha kya hai jo ghar lejaaye
Kis terha apni tabahi ki khabar lejaye
english translation text:
One or two flowers may extinguish the lamps
But may no one carry away the hope of dawn
What remains with Zainab that she can take home?
How can she carry home the news of her own destruction?

arabic text:
(Paon zakhmi hai(n) to raho(n) main hai(n) pathar kaantay) 
Jaane Aabid ko kaha(n) tak yeh safar le jaaye
Paas Zainab ke bacha kya hai jo ghar lejaaye
Kis terha apni tabahi ki khabar lejaye
english translation text:
Their feet are wounded, and the roads are filled with stones and thorns
Who knows how far this journey will carry Abid?
What remains with Zainab that she can take home?
How can she carry home the news of her own destruction?

arabic text:
Boli hongi Ali Akbar ko saja ker Zainab
Chaand ko mere kissi ki na nazar le jaaye
Paas Zainab ke bacha kya hai jo ghar lejaaye
Kis terha apni tabahi ki khabar lejaye
english translation text:
Perhaps Zainab said while adorning Ali Akbar
May no one's evil eye take away my moon
What remains with Zainab that she can take home?
How can she carry home the news of her own destruction?

arabic text:
Sochti hogi yeh Bano mera bach jaaye suhaag
Hurmula mujh sai mere lakht-e-jiger lejaaye
Paas Zainab ke bacha kya hai jo ghar lejaaye
Kis terha apni tabahi ki khabar lejaye
english translation text:
Perhaps Bano hoped that her marriage would be spared
Yet Hurmala took the beloved of her heart from her
What remains with Zainab that she can take home?
How can she carry home the news of her own destruction?

arabic text:
Rakh ke ankhon ke sulagtay huwe is maqtal mei
Laash bacho(n) ki ke Shabbir ka sar lejaaye
Paas Zainab ke bacha kya hai jo ghar lejaaye
Kis terha apni tabahi ki khabar lejaye
english translation text:
With her eyes burning, in this battlefield she wonders
Should she carry the children's bodies or Shabbir's head?
What remains with Zainab that she can take home?
How can she carry home the news of her own destruction?

arabic text: Shaiyari ki meri maiyaar yehi ho gi "Nazeer"\nZikr-e-Sarwar main mujhe mout agar lejaaye
english translation text: This alone will be the standard of my poetry, "Nazeer"\nIf death takes me while I am remembering Sarwar
